title: Affine restriction comparison is monic
statement: Under the hypotheses of the affine coimage-image comparison, the restriction of its level n component to an affine open is a monomorphism.

proof.text: For the affine open U, use its canonical isomorphism with Spec of its global sections. Transport the formal category along this scheme isomorphism. The transported ideal is ofIdealTop of the ideal obtained by the Gamma-Spec ring isomorphism; this is checked by ext_of_isAffine and Ideal.map_map. Compose the resulting equivalence with the existing affine equivalence to finite modules over the adic completion.

Cokernel preservation for alpha and its kernel inclusion is proved from ambient cokernel closure: the source full-subcategory inclusion preserves the two cokernels; module restriction is a left adjoint, and whiskering preserves colimits. The target full-subcategory inclusion reflects colimits.

proof.text: Mathlib PreservesCoimage.hom_coimageImageComparison conjugates the restricted comparison to the comparison of the restricted arrow. The latter is invertible in the affine formal category. IsIso.of_isIso_fac_right makes the restricted comparison invertible. Apply the full-subcategory inclusion followed by level evaluation, whose image is definitionally the required termwise module restriction. An isomorphism is monic.
